subject.title: fix: agent turns survive unavailable optional web credentials

question: Should generic agent turns proceed when a configured web provider credential is unresolved, with failure deferred to the web tool only if it is invoked?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it deliberately changes the product policy for when configured provider credential failures stop a user-visible agent turn.

options.title: Accept deferred web-tool failure
options.body: Merge after rebase if explicit web commands remain strict and an invoked web tool reports the unavailable credential locally.

options.title: Keep global preflight failure
options.body: Reject this behavior change and retain current fail-before-dispatch handling for all active configured web credentials.

recommendation.title: Accept deferred web-tool failure
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase if explicit web commands remain strict and an invoked web tool reports the unavailable credential locally.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and carries the maintainer label, making this the strongest available routing signal for the intended failure-policy choice.
